changelog: Contacts, and a big accessibility improvement. New Contacts tab: keep your own record of the people you deal with - name, email, company - on this PC, never pushed anywhere. The useful part is nicknames: tell DensAssistant that "Bob" is also Robert Chen and it treats them as one person everywhere, merging what it knows into a single view, and it learns to spell your contacts' names correctly in meeting transcripts. Accessibility: the dashboard is now properly usable with a screen reader and a keyboard - every field has a real label, status messages like "Saved" are announced instead of only appearing, the running-timer badge is a real button you can reach with Tab, your day plan reads out what each block is rather than just an icon, buttons say what they act on ("Remove Lunch" instead of an unlabelled x), and there's a visible focus outline again. Also: your calendar, to-dos and everything else stay on this PC by default - three places where connecting a Google account quietly began pushing data out have been corrected, and it now waits until you ask.
